extraction.Name: Walter Young
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment at the time it was issued him; but the Indian Agency advised him that it would be assessed for taxes, and sold for them later, if he did not take the patent, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged it to Henry J. Abraham, of Omaha, Nebraska, for $1000.00; that he failed to make the payments on the mortgage, and that Abraham foreclosed on it, in 1925
extraction.Buyer: Henry J. Abraham of Omaha, Nebraska, foreclosed on the mortgage of $1000.00 in 1925
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the taxes, also, accumulated on the land during the life of the mortgage; that he kept the taxes paid up until 1920, when he mortgaged it
extraction.Occupation/Income: he farms for a living, which is the chief source of his income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has a wife and four children to support; family has fair health; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; the $1000.00 mortgage proceeds were put back into the place; he considers it a total loss; affidavit sworn December 14, 1928; allotment was 160 acres
